round_key_architecture.description: Task-specific supervised two-round 8+8 composition. From only PUBLIC 40 FIT pairs, evaluate a frozen parametric eight-bit nonlinear round basis F_k(v,r)=((v*k) XOR ((v<<3)&255) XOR (v>>2) XOR ((v*v)&255) XOR ((k+29*r)&255)) &255. Enumerate frozen 256 candidate initial keys in 0..255 and choose minimal total FIT bit mismatch with deterministic numeric tie-breaking. Decode unseen outputs using learned task key, with no source operator name or evaluator key; eight held CHECK public examples for the unchanged >=96/128 confidence gate. Structural form deliberately precommitted and may match the source family's inductive bias; NOT an operator-agnostic learner or proof of universal nonlinear transfer.

round_table_architecture.description: Learn two 8-bit round function lookup tables entirely from PUBLIC 40 FIT input/output pairs: round0 value from xL XOR yL keyed by xR; round1 value from xR XOR yR keyed by yL. Resolve conflicts via modal byte vote, unseen table values use nearest-known 8-bit Hamming support with deterministic numeric tie-break. No keyed generator template in this arm; extra task-specific lookup memory outside original cognitive cells.

models.affine_controls: Exact immutable AV original balanced48 and random48; same fresh source, 48 public answers, 40 FIT and 8 CHECK.

eligibility.FIT_rule: Freeze rank using only 24 FIT paired TRAIN samples, select at most one nonlinear arm only when >=1 correct Feistel pair, FP0, total paired strictly exceeds best 48-answer affine FIT control. No FIT winner means no DEV eligibility regardless of SCREEN.
eligibility.SCREEN_rule: Independently evaluate all six unchanged models on the held 24 TRAIN-SCREEN samples after FIT-only choice; selected nonlinear must keep FP0, have >=1 Feistel paired correct and strict paired superiority over best same-source equal-budget affine SCREEN control. No SCREEN retuning or alternative re-selection.
eligibility.DEV_rule: Only independently frozen newly eligible config and separate exact-head first-use qualification after all TRAIN gates. No DEV source creation in this gate.
